clusters.pick_reason: #2692's close() settles outstanding JSON-mode requests with a proper JSON-RPC error envelope (-32000, 'Connection closed') and explicitly groups outstanding request ids by stream to handle batched POSTs correctly, reusing an id's real response instead of overwriting it if one already arrived. #2600 settles the same pending POSTs with a bare '404 Session not found' HTTP response, with no mention of batched-request grouping or preserving already-resolved ids in its diff/changeset. #2600 does additionally clear a separate _requestToStreamMapping correlation leak not covered by #2692; that piece would need to be re-added on top of #2692 if not already fixed elsewhere.
